assertions: The local projection is grounded in an unexpired passed live Steam review-page report and its exact redacted snapshot digest.
The window is always partial; the resume cursor is not represented as a global high-watermark and checkpoint advancement is held.
Recommendation ID remains the item identity and semantic content changes produce an edited observation when reconciled.
Page absence is never deletion because the verified Steam route provides no explicit lifecycle tombstones.
Review text, author identity and execution authorization are absent from the public projection.
